Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
Type: Master
Master.
Put this card in play. Each Laibon gets +X stealth when hunting and
gains X+1 additional blood from the bank if successful, where X is the
number of Aye he or she has. Burn this card during your next untap
phase. Only one Guinea-Bissau Carnival may be played in a game.

Just t clarify, this mean a laibon with one Aye on xer, hunts at 2
stealth and gains 3 blood if successful, correct?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct.

Hunt at +1 stealth (normal stealth) +1 stealth (one Aye) = two stealth.
Successful hunt: gain 1 blood (normal hunt) plus additional 1+1 blood (one Aye)
= 3 blood.
